title: Correlation pack: typosquat and brand abuse (P028, WP24)
description: Names read or emitted by v3lum/correlations/typosquat.py (CR04, CR05, CR06, CR35). The rules also read the existing names lookalike / lookalike_of (relations), lookalike_matches, typosquat_lookalikes, registered, created, domain_age_days, registrant_kind, privacy_proxy, cnpj_roots, registrant_doc, nameservers, mx, a_records, first_cert_seen, ct_summary, bcb_verified_domain, is_parked, is_sinkhole, is_cdn, is_hosting, shared_ip, hostnames, blocklist_families and the finding source ids (upstream families).

attributes.cohosted_count: int: distinct domain names observed on the IP address by passive DNS or reverse-IP data; 50 or more means shared hosting, whose listings never taint a lookalike behind it (P028 cond 6)

tags.phishing_capable: lookalike domain with the facts needed to phish (registered, MX, recently registered or a fresh first certificate): an indicator, never a verdict of maliciousness (P028 cond 9)
